darius.text: Final check. No improvising after we move.

malik.text: If the car fails, I want a backup before we leave.

amara.text: The evidence channel is ready. Once we open it, there is no quiet version of this story.

ready.text: Three people. One operation. No loose ends.

start.text: We are preparing for the final operation.

travel.text: I found the remaining pressure points. We deal with them now.

threats.text: Nobody gets left behind because we were in a hurry.

secure.text: The fallback route is protected. We can still choose how this ends.

clear.text: Then we make sure nothing follows us into the final operation.

start.text: We clean up everything that can still hurt us.

travel.text: The evidence gives us more than one way in.

route-evidence.text: The safest route is the one that leaves the least uncertainty.

choose-route.text: You choose. I will make the route work.

travel.text: Bank records. This is what we came for.

access-ledger.text: Copy first. Touch nothing we cannot restore.

secure-ledger.text: The ledger is intact. That means the proof survives with us.

extract-ledger.text: Then the truth has a chance to survive the people who built this.

start.text: The last ledger is inside the bank.

darius.text: Darius moving. Malik, take the extraction. Amara, protect the record.

malik.text: I have the route. Keep the pressure off me.

amara.text: Evidence channel is live. Do not let the story disappear.

final.text: All three positions are holding. Finish it.

choice.text: This is the last decision. After this, the city remembers what we chose.

commit.text: Say it clearly. Which path are we taking?

fallback.text: Whatever we choose, the consequences belong to all three of us.

ready.text: Then lock it. No turning back.

dawn.text: We made it this far. That does not mean we won.

aftermath.text: Somebody has to look at what remains.

consequences.text: The survivors matter. So does the evidence.

leave.text: Morning is here. Veyron is still standing.

start.text: Now we survive what comes after.

free-roam.text: Look at the city. The operation is over, but the consequences are not.

epilogue.text: The ending is ours now. The world state has to remember it.

world-state.text: Whatever we lost, we carry it forward.

free-roam-unlocked.text: Free roam is open. Veyron remembers 404.

start.text: Now we see what Veyron became.

complete.text: The epilogue is complete. Free roam is open.
